description: Run one animation subcommand (pack, unpack, reorder, resize, validate, or preview) over frames or a sprite sheet. Pack writes a sheet PNG only to the explicit output path and unpack, reorder, and resize write frames only to the explicit output directory; validate and preview return read-only reports.

angle.description: sweep: band angle in degrees; only 45, 90, 135, and 180.

format.description: unpack: per-frame output format, mcpx by default.

frameSize.description: Frame size as N or WxH.

frames.description: sweep: frame count including the untouched first frame.

framesDir.description: Frames directory for pack, reorder, resize, validate, preview.

frametime.description: sweep: ticks per frame of the generated document.

holdTicks.description: sweep: ticks the first frame rests for.

inputPath.description: sweep: still image to sweep; read only, never written.

layout.description: Sheet layout: vertical, horizontal, or grid. Required for pack, unpack, and preview.

mcmetaPath.description: Explicit .mcmeta path used by unpack and validate.

mode.description: Animation subcommand: pack, sweep, unpack, reorder, resize, validate, or preview.

order.description: Frame order for reorder as i,j,...

outputDir.description: Explicit output directory for unpack, reorder, and resize.

outputPngPath.description: Explicit PNG output path. When omitted, the PNG bytes are embedded in the result instead of written to disk.

resizeMode.description: Resize sampling: nearest, box, or pixel-aware.

sheetPath.description: Sprite sheet path used as unpack input.

width.description: sweep: band width in pixels, 1 to 8.

name: animate_asset
